requirements.req_text: After successfully completing requirements 1 through 5, use the equipment you prepared for the welding process in 5(b) to do the following: (a) Using a metal scribe or soapstone, sketch your initial onto a metal plate, and weld a bead on the plate following the pattern of your initial.
